What these pictures do not show

Four review items are still open, and all four are frontend-only. /management/coverage has no column sorting and uncompacted rows — that page was never assigned to any phase. Three status tones (monitor, overdue, validation) still render grey because governance/page.tsx hardcodes a three-tone union and never calls statusTone(). And Donut accepts a click handler that /compliance never passes.

Eight further items could not be settled by measurement in either direction. They are recorded as unresolved rather than claimed — a probe that cannot distinguish the two builds is not evidence about either one.
